name: BiGRU Speech Recognition
description: Bidirectional GRU forward pass over mel frames

data.noteContent:
An acoustic model labels every frame of a recording, so it is allowed to look ahead: bidirectional runs a second GRU backwards over the same 32 frames and concatenates the two directions. That is why hidden_size is 64 but frame_head takes 128 features. The head then scores 50 phonemes at each frame, which is what a CTC loss consumes.

The input is a random tensor standing in for a mel spectrogram: this graph shows the wiring and the shapes, not a trained model. Print is (2, 32, 50). A live streaming recogniser cannot do this - it has no future frames yet.

聲學模型要為每一幀標音，所以可以往後看：bidirectional 會讓第二個 GRU 反向再掃一次同樣的 32 幀，再把兩個方向接起來。這就是為什麼 hidden_size 是 64，frame_head 卻要吃 128 個特徵。最後每一幀給出 50 個音素分數，正好是 CTC 損失要的輸入。

輸入是隨機張量，代表一段 mel 頻譜：這張圖看的是接線與形狀，不是訓練好的模型。Print 是 (2, 32, 50)。真正的即時辨識做不到這件事 — 未來的幀還沒到。

bidirectional doubles the feature dimension, not the sequence: (2, 32, 40) in, (2, 32, 128) out. Turn it off and frame_head's in_features drops to 64.

bidirectional 加倍的是特徵維度，不是序列長度：進去 (2, 32, 40)，出來 (2, 32, 128)。關掉它，frame_head 的 in_features 就要改成 64。

One Linear, applied at all 32 steps: the output is a score sequence, not a single label for the clip. Turning that sequence into words is the decoder's job, and it is not in this graph.

同一個 Linear 會作用在 32 個時間步上：輸出是一整串分數，而不是整段音訊一個標籤。要把這串分數變成文字是解碼器的工作，這張圖沒有畫。
